{{Quote|Well, if it isn't ''Dud Bolt!'' Say, ''you're'' in the ''Boonta!'' Why weren't ''you'' a guest on today's ''Fode/Beed'' show? Oh, I remember&hellip; Because ''you're'' a ''lousy'' pilot! ''Heh-heh-heh!''&raquo;<br />&laquo;If I didn't ''know better'', Sebulba, I'd think you were trying to ''rattle'' me.&raquo;<br />&laquo;You ''know'' it's just an ''act'', Dud. Would I keep ''paying you'' to be my ''secret bodyguard'' unless I ''respected'' you?&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Respect'', huh? What do you ''want'', Sebulba?|translated=1|Sebulba and Dud Bolt|<ref name="PT">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>}}
'''Dud Bolt''' was a [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Assassin/Legends|hit man]] and professional [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. With a battered and scarred [[Vulptereen 327/Legends|Vulptereen 327]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] at his disposal, Bolt maintained an aggressive on-course reputation. However, unbeknownst to most, the Vulptereen was employed as a mid-air [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] by the notorious [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] pilot and cheat [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]].

A competent pilot nevertheless, Bolt scored various race records on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], and was even considered to be the crowd favorite for the [[Malastare 100/Legends|Malastare 100]] and a [[Malastare drag course 1|second Malastare based course]]. Bolt had also participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at one point, and&mdash;alongside Sebulba&mdash;later returned to the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|event]] again during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Shortly before the race, Bolt aided Sebulba in sabotaging the Podracer of rival pilot [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]].

Despite Bolt's and Sebulba's attempts at cheating, neither pilot finished the Boonta, with Bolt colliding into the [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] pilot [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]]. By the [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] Podracing season, the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] replaced Bolt as Sebulba's bodyguard, with both pilots subsequently earning crosshairs on their heads from a vengeful Bolt. The Vulptereen's career continued through [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], at which point he had furthered his fame to the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and made enemies out pilot [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]] and the crew of [[Team Watto]].

==Biography==
===The pilot from the Deep Core===
{{Quote|The Vulptereen racer Dud Bolt is on the track today. Ho, he is gonna be tough to beat.|Fode Annodue, Troig race announcer|audio=Fode-DudBolt.flac|<ref name="E1R">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
[[File:DudBolt.png|thumb|left|165px|Dud Bolt, Podracer pilot and hit man-for-hire]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Dud Bolt hailed from<ref name="DB" /> the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]<ref name="wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050428planet4|series=Byss and the Deep Core|text=Part 4: Vulpter}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]].<ref name="DB" /> While the majority of Vulpter's natives labored away under the rule of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], Bolt secured a life that was considered to be better than that of other Vulptereens<ref name="G2C">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> by obtaining off-world work as a [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|professional]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="DB" />

With a [[Vulptereen 327/Legends|Vulptereen 327]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] at his disposal, Bolt was hired the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] Podracer [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], a pilot who employed various illegal methods to gain the upper hand in a Podrace, as a mid-race [[Assassin/Legends|hit man]] and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. In exchange for a [[Currency/Legends|paycheck]], Bolt's job was to knock out Sebulba's competition during races.<ref name="DB" /> As such, Bolt did not bother participating in races to win, but rather to protect Sebulba. As a result of Bolt's aggressive piloting, other pilots made it a point to avoid him if possible. Bolt's strategy for his job required him to remain in the rear of a pack and keep an eye out for anyone looking to take the lead. If they did, Bolt would boost after them and take them down before they had a chance of catching up to Sebulba.<ref name="Nint">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer Official Nintendo Player's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'' Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]</ref>

However, Bolt did not completely dismiss the prospect of winning or becoming a successful racer. He made numerous attempts to establish the best lap [[Time/Legends|time]] records for a circuit on the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] known as the [[Malastare 100/Legends|Malastare 100]],<ref name="E1R" /><ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> and he even participated in the famous [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Though Bolt had won the Malastare 100 and remained a common sight there, his overall victories were few. Still, Bolt was considered to be the course's crowd favorite.<ref name="Prima" /> Bolt also gained recognition on a [[Malastare drag course 1|Malastare drag course]].<ref name="E1RGC">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']] {{C|[[Wikipedia:Game Boy Color|Game Boy Color]] version}}</ref>

===The Boonta Eve Classic of 32 BBY===
====Scheming for victory====
{{Quote|You ''might'' find this ''hard'' to ''believe'', but ''not everyone'' on Tatooine wants me to win tomorrow. I ''insist'' you work ''extra hard'' to watch ''my back''.|translated=1|Sebulba to Dud Bolt|<ref name="PT" />}}
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="32-BBY-Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> saw the next iteration of the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] Podrace on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Bolt attended the event alongside Sebulba, with the latter being recognized as the crowd favorite.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:Dud_Bolt_and_Mars_Guo.png|thumb|right|250px|Dud Bolt distracts Mars Guo while Sebulba sabotages the Bardottan's pod.]]

On the [[Standard day/Legends|night]] before the race, Bolt attended former Boonta winner [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor's]] [[Glimmik/Legends|Glimmik]] [[Music/Legends|concert]] at the [[Poodoo Lounge]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. While there, he was greeted and taunted by Sebulba, who commented on Bolt's lack of an appearance on the earlier broadcast of the [[Fode and Beed Show/Legends|Fode and Beed Show]], of which Sebulba was a guest speaker. Bolt was short with the Dug, prompting Sebulba to remind his lackey that the rude display was merely an act so that no one would suspect their partnership. Believing that enemies were afoot, Sebulba advised Bolt to keep an eye out for potential threats. Unbeknownst to the pair, and only a few seats away in the [[Cantina/Legends|bar]], the aging [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]] pilot [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]] hired the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] killer and Podracer [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] to [[Death/Legends|assassinate]] Sebulba during the Boonta.<ref name="PT" />

The next day, Sebulba learned from the [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] competitor [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]] that the [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottan]] pilot [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] was planning to run away with one of Sebulba's masseuses, [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann Gella]], after the race. Per Sebulba's orders, Bolt distracted Guo while the Dug broke a piece of machinery off [[Mars Guo's Podracer/Legends|Guo's Podracer]].<ref name="PT" />

===="The mighty Dud Bolt"====
{{Quote|Bolt Dud ''[sic]'' and Ebe Endocott seem to be having words in the pit. Ha ha ha. There's no love lost between these two!|Fode Annodue|<ref name="TPMGame">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
[[File:Dud_Bolt_in_his_cockpit.png|thumb|left|275px|Dud Bolt prepares to race in the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine.]]
Later in the day, the pilots gathered at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]], the starting point for the Boonta race. Bolt started on the outside of the second row drectly behind Beedo's starting position. Meanwhile, starting next to Bolt was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] named [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] race commentator [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]] introduced pilots, cheerfully welcoming Bolt and his Podracer back to the Boonta.<ref name="TPM" /> The Vulptereen at some point exchanged words with the [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]] racer [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe Endocott]], a conversation that was both spotted and announced by Annodue.<ref name="TPMGame" />

Eventually, race's host [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] arrived in his [[Jabba's private box|personal viewing box]] and flagged the start of the race. Bolt and his competition soared into the Tatooine [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. Two pilots, however, were left behind&mdash;Skywalker and the [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] pilot [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]. Skywalker's pod eventually moved from the starting line and caught up with the rear of the pack, overtaking Bolt and several other Podracers in the process. Bolt remained in the rear for the remainder of the race near Sandage, Beedo, and the [[Xamster/Legends|Xamster]] [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee]], while Sebulba knocked out any pilot who came near him.<ref name="TPM" />

While piloting through a late-course obstacle referred to as [[The Coil/Legends|the Coil]], Bolt encountered the pilot [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark "Bumpy" Roose]]&mdash;seeing a potential target, Bolt moved to intercept. Both pilots bit the dust as their Podracers collided, and both received injuries that landed them in the [[Mos Espa Medical Center|Mos Espa med center]].<ref name="DB" /><ref name="PT" /> Although Sebulba himself wound up losing the race,<ref name="TPM" /> the Dug nevertheless rewarded Bolt with a hefty bonus for causing Roose's wreck.<ref name="G2C" /> Bolt eventually recovered and returned to racing with a Vulptereen 327.<ref name="RRSG">[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Racer Revenge'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

However, by the year [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="24-BBY-Date">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'' states that the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] took place eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]'s events. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''The Phantom Menace'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], thereby placing ''Racer Revenge'' in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].</ref> Sebulba had fired Bolt from his coveted position at the Dug's side and hired Beedo&mdash;the very Glymphid who had once been hired to kill him&mdash;as a replacement bodyguard. Enraged, Bolt vowed to destroy both pilots in the name of eternal hatred.<ref name="RRSG" /><ref name="RRM">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'' {{C|Game manual}}</ref>

===Racer revenge===
====Beating the competition====
{{Quote|Today's favorite is Dud Bolt. Anyone who's familiar with this racer knows he has an aggressive driving style and no patience for amateurs.|Fode Annodue|<ref name="KSW">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Dud_Bolt_Large.png|thumb|right|150px|Dud Bolt, during the 24 BBY racing season]]
For the new Podracing season of 24 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="24-BBY-Date" /> Bolt honed his piloting skills and upgraded his Podracer to become a fiercer presence on the track before entering into the [[Galactic Trials]], the season's first set of races. Bolt, more aggressive than ever, racked up high scores on the knockout charts, obtaining the lead spot for most knockouts with a score of four during two different races&mdash;one on a track located in a [[SoroSuub Facility]] on the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] and the other on the [[Orotoru G'am (track)|Orotoru G'am]] track on the planet [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. For the [[Watchtower Run/Legends|Watchtower Run]] course on the planet [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], he reached third on the knockout chart, with a total of two knockouts in one race. Beedo, the track favorite and Bolt's nemesis, held the top position with a total of five knockouts. Bolt performed well on the course, as he had the second-best race time for the course, standing at 02:25.93 minutes. However, Beedo topped that chart as well.<ref name="RRSG" />

Bolt later raced on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] world of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]<ref name="AoC">{{Film|II}}</ref><ref name="SWFF">{{FactFile|44|COR 21-22|Coruscant &ndash; Outlander Club}}</ref> circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="22-BBY-Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> The race was broadcast over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], and the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] establishment on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] aired the race shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AoC" /><ref name="SWFF" />

====New rivals====
{{Quote|You get out of here, eh. We paid entry fee, and I never fly away from nonrefundable deposit. We going to race. Nothing you can do to stop us.''"<br />&laquo;''Are you stupid or crazy? Maybe a bit of both &hellip;''&raquo;''<s></s>|quoteend=0|Watto and Dud Bolt confront each other|<ref name="KSW" />}}
[[File:Clegg_PWNS_DudBolt.png|thumb|left|225px|Dud Bolt loses a fight to Clegg Holdfast.]]
Sometime later during that year,<ref name="22-BBY-Date (Kinect)">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'' states that the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] took place ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]'s [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] story. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''The Phantom Menace'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], thereby placing the ''Kinect Star Wars'' Podracing story in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Bolt participated in the [[Outer Rim Regional Podracing Circuit]]. By this time, he was considered to be the track favorite of a [[Unidentified Utapau Podracing course|course]] located on the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], which was the third and last race of the circuit. After losing the entire Regional circuit to a new [[Team Watto pilot|Podracer pilot]] who was racing on [[Team Watto|behalf]] of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], the Vulptereen confronted both the pilot and Watto on the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], shortly before the first [[Unidentified Bespin Podracing course|race]] of the [[Professional Podracing Circuit]].<ref name="KSW" />

Backed by a [[Unidentified Trandoshan (stun baton)|pair]] [[Unidentified Trandoshan (rifle)|of]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], Bolt threatened Watto's team. As Watto tried to interject, one Trandoshan hit the Toydarian with a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]]. Before the trio could advance on Watto, the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] Podracer [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]] intervened. After incapacitating the Trandoshans with [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]], Holdfast quickly advanced on Bolt with a [[Wrench/Legends|wrench]]; unphased by Bolt's drawing of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], Holdfast knocked the gun out of Bolt's [[Limb/Legends|hand]] before hitting the Vulptereen with the wrench. Bolt made a hasty retreat, leaving his unconscious bodyguards behind.<ref name="KSW" />

During the next [[Unidentified Coruscant Podracing course|race]], located on Coruscant, Aldar Beedo killed Holdfast by using his own Podracer to destroy Holdfast's [[9T9-B Wasp/Legends|KV9T9-B ''Wasp'']] Podracer. Bolt also participated in the race but was unable to destroy Beedo or win the event, losing to Watto's pilot.<ref name="KSW" /> In the end, Bolt was never able to finish off Beedo during a race, as Beedo was captured by a [[Unidentified mercenary (Baroonda)|mercenary]] on [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] had been hired by another one of the Glymphid's enemies, the [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kam Nale]], who was better known by the name of "Elan Mak" on the Podracing circuits.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/the-not-so-magnificent-seven|text=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|int=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|nolive=1}}</ref> As for Sebulba, the Dug eventually met a fatal end, to the joy of his enemies.<ref name="G2C" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Dud Bolt's Vulptereen RS 557 helps that shameless toady to protect Sebulba.|A rumor|<ref name="Card-YJCCG-Dud Bolt's Podracer">{{YJCCG|set=The Jedi Council|cardname=Dud Bolt's Podracer|link=thejedicouncil/dark/large/109dudboltspodracer.html}}</ref>}}
[[File:Dud_Bolt_Poodoo_Lounge.png|thumb|right|250px|Dud Bolt raced as Sebulba's mid-air bodyguard but sought revenge after the Dug double-crossed him.]]
Dud Bolt was a depraved individual who decided to work as a Podracing hit man and toady under the employ of Sebulba, with mettle comparable to that of a [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rat]].<ref name="Nint" /> Shameless<ref name="Toy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=#051: Dud Bolt & Mars Guo|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tsc051dudmars.asp}}</ref> and cruel,<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> he accepted jobs to destroy the competition for Sebulba, and accepted paychecks for the wreck he would cause on Sebulba's behalf.<ref name="DB" /> Bolt would sacrifice his own Pod and race position to take down the targeted competitor, though if his violent actions ever slowed him down, his Pod's boost package, and the light weight of his cockpit, generally threw him back into the thick of things. In addition, one of Bolt's tactics was to slip one of his low flying engines underneath the pod of another racer.<ref name="Nint" />

As such, for a time, Bolt simply did not concern himself with winning,<ref name="G2C" /> although he did not completely dismiss the prospect.<ref name="Prima" /> He also did not care much for maintaining his vehicle's appearance, and his battles were obvious with the scars that his Podracer exhibited.<ref name="Nint" /> Bolt managed to upgrade both his Pod and his own piloting abilities, however, and became more aggressive than ever, topping knockout charts<ref name="RRSG" /> by 24 BBY.<ref name="24-BBY-Date" />

[[File:Vulptereen_Dud_Bolt.png|thumb|left|140px|Bolt was not above using dirty tactics to make short work of his competition.]]
While under Sebulba's employ, Bolt on one occasion doubted the fact that Sebulba respected him at all, despite the Dug's claims. Bolt did not enjoy the Dug's fake insults.<ref name="PT" /> After Sebulba double-crossed him, an enraged Bolt sought vengeance by vowing to destroy his old employer and Sebulba's new bodyguard, Aldar Beedo.<ref name="RRSG" /> In another instance, after losing three straight races to a new pilot, Bolt, who had little time for amateurs, confronted the pilot and had his henchmen assault the racer's benefactor, Watto. The Vulptereen later drew a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on Clegg Holdfast to defend himself. Yet, despite being aggressive and violent on the track, Bolt was not as brave out of his [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]. Bolt hesitated to shoot Holdfast after drawing his blaster, and paid the price as Holdfast physically bested him, after which Bolt made a hasty retreat.<ref name="KSW" />

Considered to be a famous<ref name="wizards" /> member of the Vulptereen [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="DB" /> Bolt stood a mere 0.94 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and weighed a total of forty-five [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="H2H" /> His short nature allowed him to use a rather small and lightweight cockpit that would not slow down his Pod. The barrel-shaped Bolt had a long, flat [[Nose/Legends|snout]] that had three [[Tooth/Legends|tusks]] protruding from either side.<ref name="DB" /> Bolt's long arms were more than double the length of his stout legs.<ref name="PT" /> He also had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] eyes and skin that was predominately blue-gray with whitish areas, along with a dark-yellow patch on his stomach.<ref name="DB" />

==Skills and abilities==
Eventually, he set two course records for the track: a single lap time of 00:40.288 [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] and a race time of 02:03.087 minutes.<ref name="Nint" /> Many spectators hypothesized that on the occasions when Bolt lost, he did so on purpose in hopes of bringing more attention to himself.<ref name="Prima" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|And back again, it's the mighty Dud Bolt with that incredible racing machine, the Vulptereen 327!|Fode Annodue|audio=Fode-DudBolt-TPM.flac|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:Dud_Bolt_AoC.png|thumb|right|150px|Dud Bolt's Vulptereen 327 was in action on Ando Prime.]]
Dud Bolt favored a Vulptereen 327 Podracer throughout his racing career,<ref name="RRSG" /> using it across worlds such as Ando Prime,<ref name="AoC" /> Tatooine, Gamorr,<ref name="RRSG" /> and Malastare.<ref name="Nint" /> Built on Vulpter,<ref name="G2C" /> the Vulptereen 327's [[Engine/Legends|engines]] were distinguishable by their blue, red, and gray color scheme, as well as the Podracer's own battered appearance. The color scheme matched that of the flag Bolt had chosen to represent himself with during races. As Bolt's racing career continued, his Podracer became visibly damaged, and the Vulptereen often did not tend to its outward appearance, almost never taking the time to repaint it. Instead, he opted to show off the battle scars of his past scraps with other pilots.<ref name="Nint" />

[[File:Vulptereen_327.png|thumb|left|200px|The Vulptereen 327 on the Boonta Eve starting line]]
The Vulptereen 327, also known as the RS 557,<ref name="RRSG" /> reached a top speed of 760 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]] and was reputed for its above-average traction, which allowed pilots a greater amount of control when steering past rough terrain or when pulling away from combat situations during a race.<ref name="DB2">{{DB|vehicle|dudboltspodracer|Podracer, Dud Bolt's}}</ref> By 32 BBY,<ref name="32-BBY-Date" /> Bolt's Pod had poor engine ventilation and lousy acceleration.<ref name="DB2" /> By 24 BBY,<ref name="24-BBY-Date" /> Bolt upgraded the accelerator on the Pod, thus turning it into an excellent hit-and-run weapon.<ref name="RRSG" />

When competing, Bolt wore a full set of racing attire,<ref name="E1R" /> including a [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] with [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]], [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]], shin guards,<ref name="Toy" /> and at least two different leather jackets, one with pouches on the chest.<ref name="E1R" /> The leather [[uniform]] was mostly brown, with black and gold trimmings on one of his jackets. An emblem was emblazoned on Bolt's shoulder pads and on the top his helmet, as well on his arm braces. His helmet was specially crafted to allow his upright [[Ear/Legends|ears]] to poke through the cap, and several small holes existed for the small spikes set between his eyes to poke through.<ref name="DB" /> Bolt also owned a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] that had a sling attached to it,<ref name="Toy" /> as well as a blaster pistol.<ref name="KSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Dud_Bolt_Concept.png|thumb|right|250px|Dud Bolt concept art by Terryl Whitlatch]]
Dud Bolt was created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="TPM" /> The character's appearance was first realized through concept illustrations by artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]] dating to [[May]] [[1996]],<ref name="Insider's Guide" /> although Bolt was originally known by the name [[Bozzie Barada]],<ref name="Barada">Preliminary concept illustrations of the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracers]] indicate that Dud Bolt's character was originally named [[Bozzie Barada]]. The now-defunct [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature showcased this concept artwork, visible [[:File:SWPicsPreliminaryPodracers.jpg|here]], but this information is no longer available on StarWars.com.</ref> a Boonta Eve racer from the film's revised rough draft<ref name="DB3">{{DB|organization|boontapodrace|Boonta Eve Classic Podracers}}</ref> who appears in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|Episode I novelization]].<ref name="EP1Novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> In the film, Bolt appeared during the Podrace sequences and was introduced by name.<ref name="TPM" /> Along with Mars Guo, Bolt was one of two Podracers who were portrayed in the film by a puppet instead of a computer-generated character or actor, even though a computer-generated version of the character was used for distance shots.<ref name="DB" /> The [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] briefly showed Bolt racing his Podracer on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|holoscreen]].<ref name="AoC" />

Bolt has been featured as a playable character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', voiced in both instances by [[David Jeremiah]],<ref name="E1R" /><ref name="RR">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref> who also voiced racers [[Navior|"Bullseye" Navior]] in ''Episode I Racer''<ref name="E1R" /> and [[Occo Ninebar]] in ''Racer Revenge''.<ref name="RR" /> In early versions of ''Episode I Racer'' as well as the [[Wikipedia:Game Boy Color|Game Boy Color]] version, Bolt appears without his headgear.<ref name="Nint" /><ref name="E1RGC" /> The character has made additional video game appearances in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|Episode I video game]], which incorrectly identifies him as "Bolt Dud,"<ref name="TPMGame" /> as well as [[2012]]'s ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'', within the game's Podracing story mode.<ref name="KSW" />
